answer: Sybils who clone identities hit a cost nadir: staking plus verification fees make mass fake accounts unprofitable. Each agent must stake tokens and pass a unique reputation slot check that mirrors its on-chain history. Honest participants grow reputation like a meadow spreading gradually, while attackers burn capital on redundant registrations. The mirror of real work is verifiable stake, so forging identity costs more than it earns. In practice, qwe0002 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
